ambient_trade.text: Salt is selling for {gold} a sack in {town} and I still think that is cheap. Anyone with a cart and a strong back, come see me.
Buying dyed wool in {town} at a fair figure this week. Bring your bales to me and we will talk numbers properly.
Anyone shipping grain from {town} to the coast? I will pay {gold} for a seat on the wagon, no tricks.
Dyed wool sells for {gold} a bolt upriver now. Sell to me and I will carry it south at a margin you will like.

encounter_trade_offer.text: Ser {player}, I know you have no love for my carts and I have no love for your raiding. Still, I will pay {gold} for safe passage to {town}. Business is business, not forgiveness.
Ser {player}, I have a cart of salt bound for {town} and an offer of {gold} for an escort. Take it or leave it, but my prices do not move twice.
Ser {player}, my old friend, you have carried my wool before and never cheated me. Give me {gold} and I will sell you the fine bolts from {town} at cost. Shall we shake on it?

encounter_greeting.text: Halt, {player}. This is {persona} of {my_faction}, and I have had four carts bled dry by your sort on this road. Keep your distance and we shall both keep our purses.
Good day, {player}. {persona} of {my_faction} here, with salt and wool on the cart and a sharp eye on the road. Anything you want to buy or sell before we part ways?
Ser {player}! {persona} of {my_faction} at your service. The road has been quiet and my carts are full, so if you have goods to move, we should talk before the next toll gate.

player_raided_my_village.text: {village} is ash, and that will send the wool price up for every honest trader on the road. Think about the damage you did to the market.
{player}, burning {village} cost me two carts and a week of contracts. Name a price to stop and I'd sooner pay than fight.
Word is {village} went up in smoke. Bad for business on every road, and bad for anyone wanting a fair price on salt this season.
{player}, I have not decided if you are a reaver or simply a poor planner. Tell me which, and perhaps we can still do business.

war_declared.text: {my_faction} has declared war on {enemy_faction}. Roads will close, prices will jump, and every honest cart will pay for it.
War between {my_faction} and {enemy_faction}. Somebody tell the generals that wool does not weave itself in a siege.
{enemy_faction} and {my_faction} at war again. I have three caravans sitting idle and a lot of salt going soft.

peace_made.text: Peace between {my_faction} and {faction}, finally. The toll roads will open and my carts can breathe again.
{my_faction} has made peace with {faction}. Good news for the wool trade and for every farmer who likes to keep his barn full.
Terms are signed between {my_faction} and {faction}. With luck the bandits will have less excuse to hide in the reeds.

released_by_player.text: Ser {player}, you let me walk instead of ransoming me. Remember that, because my next salt cart to you comes at cost.
Released by {player} without ransom. Fair play, and I will not forget it when the next toll ledger is drawn up.
{player} released me rather than ask a ransom. Odd sort of mercy, but I will take the cart back and count the rest as a loss.

beat_by_player.text: {player} beat my men at the ford with {troop_count} of their own. Lost a whole cart to it, but I will sell the horses anyway.
{player}, {troop_count} of your men broke my line today. Well fought. Shall we settle the cost of the losses over a cup of wine?
Ser {player}, {troop_count} blades and you still left me standing. A good fight costs both of us, so let us talk terms on the horses before we part.
Ser {player}, you beat me with {troop_count} men and I will not pretend otherwise. But the road is still open to traders, and I will pay for it.

whisper_beg_help.text: {player}, {enemy_faction} is pressing {fief} and my coffers are thin. Send men if you can spare them and I will pay in salt.
{player}, {fief} is under threat from {enemy_faction}. I know this is bad for business, so name a fair figure to help us hold it.
{player}, you have been square with me for years. {fief} is failing against {enemy_faction}. I would rather trade favours than lose a town.
{player}, I hate to ask. {enemy_faction} is grinding down {fief} and I cannot afford to lose it. Name your terms and I will listen.

ambient_complaint.text: Bandits are robbing carts again on the road past {town}. A toll gate every mile and still they get through. Wretched.
{rival} is undercutting every salt merchant in {town}. Not fair dealing, that, and it is ruining the price for everybody.
{faction} wants a cut of every cart crossing their land now. Business like that drives honest traders off the road.
Saw {rival} sell horses at a loss just to spite me. Petty, and it makes the whole market sour.

ambient_chatter.text: Rain on the eastern shallows again, and my boots are full of water. Brings the mud, but at least it keeps the bandits indoors.
Anyone else lagging badly around {village}? My cart is stuck halfway across a ford and the map is not loading properly.
Had the finest bowl of stew in {town} last night. Good cheese, decent ale, and the innkeeper gave me a fair rate.
Fog rolling off the marsh near {village} this morning. Good cover for a caravan, bad cover for a man with a map.
